research_question: Which Data Science job roles and companies show highest demand?
key_finding: Data Scientist (35.2%), ML Engineer (21.4%), Data Analyst (15.8%) comprise 72.4% of requisitions across 642 hiring organizations.

research_question: How does required experience relate to advertised salary?
key_finding: Linear elasticity beta = 1.98L per year (R2 = 0.352, p < 1e-134); salary spread expands sharply above 5 years experience.

research_question: Which locations demonstrate greatest analytics job demand?
key_finding: Tri-metro concentration: Bengaluru (43.8%), NCR (14.2%), Mumbai (10.5%); NCR and Mumbai command positive Haberman residuals (+3.54, +2.67).

research_question: Which technical skills appear most frequently in Analytics postings?
key_finding: SQL (48.2%) and Python (39.5%) are baseline table stakes; ML (21.6%), Big Data (19.2%), R (16.5%), SAS (15.2%) form specialized clusters.

research_question: Which skills are associated with higher observed salary levels?
key_finding: Spark (AOR=1.59), ML (AOR=1.58), R (AOR=1.56), and SAS (AOR=1.47) command significant premia; SQL and Python do not (AOR ~1.0).

research_question: Which technical skill dimensions associate with junior salary hikes?
key_finding: Storytelling (AOR=3.23, Rank #1) and Maths/Stats (AOR=3.65, Rank #2) dominate; Big Data contributes negligible signal (p=0.217, Rank #5).

research_question: Which personality dimensions associate with senior consulting success?
key_finding: Openness (AOR=7.72, Rank #1) and Conscientiousness (AOR=8.11, Rank #2) predict success with 92.7% accuracy; Neuroticism has near-zero predictive value.

research_question: Can interpretable classifiers predict junior salary hikes and senior success?
key_finding: Ridge Logistic Regression achieves ROC-AUC = 0.9035 (JDS) and 0.9699 (SDS) under 25-split CV; parsimonious linear models match or exceed ensembles.

research_question: How can multi-lens evidence be synthesized into a career framework?
key_finding: Triangulated into a 4-Quadrant Talent Matrix, 4-Stage Progression Roadmap, and Four Stakeholder Blueprints without row-level joins.
